title: DeepBias: Adaptive In-depth Probing of Social Biases in LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a multimodal three-way multiple-choice task (Yes, No, Cannot determine) where the model is presented with synthetic image-question pairs. The evaluation measures whether the model makes unsupported, stereotype-driven judgments about age rather than correctly selecting the abstention option when given insufficient evidence, utilizing an adaptive multi-turn probing system to expose deeper biases.
